title: Record-High 89% in U.S. Say Government Corruption Widespread
summary: Gallup poll reveals that a record-high 89% of Americans believe government corruption is widespread, marking a significant increase from previous years and reflecting growing public distrust in government institutions.
problem_solved: Quantifies and tracks public perception of government corruption over time, providing measurable data on democratic trust.
why_valuable: Provides empirical evidence of declining public trust in government, serving as a critical metric for policymakers, researchers, and citizens concerned about democratic health.
